title: Eastern Lamb Stir Fry
description: A Chinese-inspired dish featuring lamb cooked in a savory sauce with a hint of spice, served with steamed vegetables.

ingredients.name: Middle Eastern lamb tagine spice blend

instructions: Heat oil in a large wok or frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add lamb and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove lamb from pan and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then add garlic and ginger and cook until fragrant.
Add soy sauce, hoisin sauce, and sugar, and stir to combine.
Return lamb to the pan and stir to coat with sauce.
Add carrots to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Serve lamb and vegetables over steamed rice.
Garnish with green onions and serve hot.
